newsitem.title: USA: Centennial buys ViA Inc of Minnesota.
newsitem.headline: Centennial buys ViA Inc of Minnesota.

text.p: Centennial Technologies Inc said Monday that it acquired a 12 percent interest in ViA Inc, a privately held technology company that makes a personal computer that is wearable as a belt.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Centennial designs, makes and markets PC card-based solutions. Centennial shares climbed 5-1/2 Monday to 46-3/4.

ViA of Northfield, Minnesota, designs, makes and markets miniature communication and computing products. Its patent provides hands-free communication and computing through voice recognition technology and modular PCMCIA cards, Centennial said.
"Centennial's acquisition of an interest in ViA reflects our continuing strategy to invest in companies making exciting advances in complementary technologies," Centennial said in a statement.
